fullPassage: Traveling to see your favorite team or athlete compete is becoming increasingly common, and the cities hosting sporting events are eager to welcome tourists. From an economic standpoint, the hosts stand to earn huge profits. Visiting sports fans don’t just buy tickets to attend the sports matches; they spend on hotels, restaurants, and shopping as well. Big sporting events also bring positive attention to host cities, which helps attract more visitors later during non-sporting events. Of course, cities can improve their reputation if the events run smoothly, but that’s not easy considering the logistical challenges of providing transportation, security, and accommodation to thousands of visitors. Moreover, these events may face opposition from the local residents, who have to deal with traffic delays and overall crowdedness. It is, therefore, imperative for hosts to carefully coordinate the events and proactively engage with local communities to address concerns. Only through effective management and a focus on minimizing disruptions can organizers enjoy the full benefits of sports tourism while ensuring a positive experience for both visitors and residents.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

② to earn ✅ 적절 — 'stand to + 동사원형(~할 가능성이 있다)'의 to부정사
③ spend ✅ 적절 — 복수주어 they(fans)에 맞는 복수동사
④ face ✅ 적절 — 조동사 may 뒤의 동사원형
det.tip: 동명사구/to부정사구 주어는 단수 취급 → 단수동사(is)
